title: Patient Payment Plan Training Bulletin: The Balance an Unsigned Offer Is Re-figured On
content:
The re-figure balance of an unsigned **Patient Payment Plan** offer follows what has happened to the enrolled accounts. Billing holds are read from the patient's hospital accounts in the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing); enrollments and reductions from the offer itself.

**Rule.**
- When the first of the patient's accounts listed on a charge-dispute billing hold is an account enrolled on the offer, the re-figure balance is the enrolled total less the amount enrolled for that account, which leaves the offer while the dispute is open.
- When that does not apply and reductions have been booked on the offer, it is the offer's ledger balance, the amounts enrolled less the reductions booked.
- Otherwise it is the enrolled total.

**Q. Accounts enrolled at 900.00 and 600.00; the 600.00 account is the first of the patient's accounts listed on a charge-dispute hold.**
A. 1500.00 less 600.00: the re-figure balance is 900.00. A reduction booked on the offer does not change this figure.

**Q. Same offer, no account on a charge-dispute hold, a 200.00 charity reduction booked.**
A. 1500.00 less 200.00: 1300.00.

**Q. The first account listed on a charge-dispute hold is not enrolled on this offer, and no reduction is booked.**
A. The enrolled total, 1500.00.
